text: {"rules":[{"id":"VAR-2DOSE-7-18","version":"2025","title":"Varicella 2-dose series for persons age 7-18 years without evidence of immunity","source_quote":"Ensure persons age 7–18 years without evidence of immunity","grade":"not graded (ACIP/CDC routine and catch-up recommendation)","effective_date":"2025","action":"Ensure a 2-dose varicella-containing vaccine series (VAR or MMRV) has been received","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 7, \"max\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"persons age 7–18 years\"}","numerator":"{\"any\": [{\"immunization\": {\"concept\": \"varicella_vaccine\", \"min_count\": 2, \"window\": [\"{MY-18}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"2-dose series\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"lifetime lookback: a patient aged 18 at end of MY was born no earlier than {MY-18}-01-01\"}}, {\"immunization\": {\"concept\": \"mmrv_vaccine\", \"min_count\": 2, \"window\": [\"{MY-18}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"2-dose series\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"lifetime lookback: a patient aged 18 at end of MY was born no earlier than {MY-18}-01-01\"}}], \"quote\": \"VAR or MMRV may be administered\", \"note\": \"Mixed series (1 VAR + 1 MMRV) cannot be counted with this grammar; see coverage_notes\"}","exclusions":"[{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"evidence of varicella immunity (history of disease, laboratory evidence, or birth-year criteria per MMWR rr5604)\"}, \"quote\": \"without evidence of immunity\"}]"}],"coverage_notes":["Routine schedule timing (dose 1 at 12–15 months, dose 2 at 4–6 years) is not encoded as separate age-specific rules; ages are whole years and a dose-1-by-age-2 or dose-2-by-age-7 rule would require derived thresholds. The age 7–18 rule covers completion of the series.","Mixed series counting (one VAR dose plus one MMRV dose = 2 valid doses) cannot be expressed: the numerator counts VAR and MMRV separately and may under-count patients with a mixed series.","Minimum age 12 months: doses given before 12 months are invalid but are not excluded from the dose count.","Minimum intervals not represented: dose 2 as early as 3 months after dose 1 (dose after at least 4 weeks may be counted valid); catch-up intervals of 3 months for age 7–12 years and 4–8 weeks (minimum 4 weeks) for age 13 years and older.","Product choice not represented: for dose 1 at age 12–47 months, separate MMR and varicella vaccines recommended; MMRV may be used on parent/caregiver preference; maximum age for MMRV is 12 years.","Evidence of immunity criteria (MMWR rr5604) encoded only as an uncomputable exclusion."]}
